summary: Improve borrower analysis, facility structuring and credit-line monitoring. Build practical credit work products in this five-day course.
lede: Corporate credit decision-making training covers how to assess borrower capacity, structure revolving facilities and monitor approved credit lines. It is for commercial credit analysts, underwriters, and relationship or portfolio managers who review borrower information and support approval, renewal, amendment, or decline decisions. Participants practise cash-flow and sensitivity analysis, recommend limits and covenants, calculate borrowing-base availability, and document exceptions and review decisions using spreadsheets and borrower cases.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review commercial borrower information, recommend revolving facility terms or maintain approved credit lines. It suits intermediate practitioners who need more consistent analysis, documentation and portfolio follow-up.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of commercial borrower financial statements and the commercial lending or credit review process is expected. No coding or programming is required.
